rationale: The first reply was well judged: it correctly read 'EO3' plus a buzzing pump as a drain-pump issue, insisted on 'switch off and unplug the machine first', and set a proportionate impeller-spin check that led straight to the hidden truth. The customer's report of a free-spinning impeller with a snapped fin fully supports the final 'Yes, the pump needs replacing', so the part recommendation is justified. However the closing turn is bare: it gives no guidance on draining residual water and isolating power before removing the pump, does not tie the part to the H3DS4965DACE model he supplied, and misses the relevant point that Hoover's parts warranty may cover the pump, which the ground truth flags as something to mention before DIY.
